subject: Re: Kickoff: bang-bang QAOA protocol search
body:
Anders,

Resourcing:

- Staffing: Umar 50%, Ondrej 60%, Wei 40% through the window. Ondrej leads the distributed search implementation.
- Good news on compute: the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-06-29 is ours - 256 accelerators - and that's when we run the distributed protocol search at paper scale. State-vector simulation of the protocol evaluations is what actually needs the accelerators; the stochastic descent wrapper is cheap. I picked the week right after the 6/22-6/24 Vulcan maintenance so we won't get preempted mid-sweep.
- Until then, everything runs single-machine on titan-a100 best-effort, which covers the 10-literal/10-clause reproduction fine.

Budget-wise this stays inside the portfolio compute envelope; no discretionary ask.

Alina
